messages.content: 你能使用 get_stock_prices 函數來檢索蘋果、微軟、亞馬遜和特斯拉分別在1週、2週、3週和1個月的時間範圍內的股價嗎？。

function.name: get_stock_prices
function.description: Retrieves stock prices for specified companies and duration. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

companies.description: List of companies to retrieve stock prices for.

duration.description: Time duration to retrieve stock prices for. E.g., '1 week', '2 weeks', '1 month', etc.

message.reasoning: The user wants to use get_stock_prices function to retrieve stock prices for Apple, Microsoft, Amazon, Tesla for durations 1 week, 2 weeks, 3 weeks, 1 month. They want separate durations for each company? The phrasing: "蘋果、微軟、亞馬遜和特斯拉分別在1週、2週、3週和1個月的時間範圍內的股價" means each company has a different duration: Apple 1 week, Microsoft 2 weeks, Amazon 3 weeks, Tesla 1 month. So we need to call get_stock_prices with companies array and duration string. But the function signature expects companies: string[] and duration: string. It seems we can only pass one duration for all companies. But we need separate durations. We might need to call the function multiple times: one for each company with its duration. The user asked "能使用 get_stock_prices 函数来检索...?" So we should respond with calls to the function. We can do multiple calls. The user didn't specify how many calls. We can do four calls. Each call: companies: [company], duration: "1 week" etc. Let's do that.
